coach.title: Coach
coach.body: A report across every deck you play: what keeps happening, where lost games turn, and what to read next. It is written when you ask for it.

field.title: The {{format}} field, and you against it
field.notPlayedLastDays: not played in the last {{days}} days
field.barsWithDeck: Bars are each deck's share of {{lists}} tournament lists. The line under each is your own record with {{deck}} in the same period.
field.barsNoDeck: Bars are each deck's share of {{lists}} tournament lists. The line under each is your own record in the same period.
field.listShort: Your record is counted over your last 500 matches.

firstRun.title: This page fills in as you play
firstRun.lead: Sensei Top reads the log Arena writes while you play. Nothing is recorded yet.
firstRun.logDetail: Nothing has arrived from Arena yet. Start Arena. If it is already open, turn on Detailed Logs (Plugin Support) in Arena, under Options, then Account, and start Arena again.
firstRun.playDetail: The tracker can see Arena. Play a match, and it appears here when it ends.
firstRun.appear1: Your last session in one line, and your record over the last 30 days.
firstRun.appear2: Three things worth a look: your last match, a pattern across your matches, and the field.
firstRun.appear3: Your recent matches, your win rate by week and your decks.
firstRun.mtgoLead: Sensei Top reads the game logs Magic Online writes while you play. Nothing is recorded yet.
firstRun.mtgoFolderTitle: It is watching Magic Online's folder
firstRun.mtgoFolderDetail: No folder of game logs is set yet. Set it in Settings, under Sources.
firstRun.mtgoPlayDetail: Each game is read once it ends, and the match appears here.
firstRun.mtgoNotWatching: The tracker is running without watching Magic Online's folder, so a game played now is not recorded. Restart the tracker with watching turned on.
firstRun.mtgoWatcherStopped: The tracker stopped watching after it started, so a game played now is not recorded. Restart the tracker; its log file says what went wrong.

needsDeck.title: Needs a deck
needsDeck.subtitle: MTGO's log does not say which deck you played. Pick it on the match so it counts toward that deck.

patterns.title: Patterns start at 20 matches
patterns.body_one: A pattern compares at least 10 matches that have something with 10 that do not. You have {{count}} won or lost match with a recognized deck.
patterns.body_other: A pattern compares at least 10 matches that have something with 10 that do not. You have {{count}} won or lost matches with a recognized deck.

weekly.single: You went {{record}} in the week of {{week}}. The chart starts with a second week.
weekly.hollow: A hollow dot is a week with fewer than ten matches.

detailedLogs.body: Without them, no Arena match is recorded.
